challenge.better_approach: I looked at exempting exception classes in the sieve. That would weaken a deterministic red, and Akien ruled that everybody inherits the mixin. The one-base change is what e8b58520aeb9 did for the base tool's eleven exceptions.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That DiagnosticBase's cooperative __init__ passes the message through to RuntimeError. Measured: AmbiguousComponent(DiagnosticBase, LookupError) works the same way, and the proof's tooth 2 holds str and args.
challenge.prior_art: e8b58520aeb9 (base classes) and 819cbe3a9927 (bus_client) are the same conversion, with the same proof shape. grep over CairnCommons/tickets finds no ticket naming InspectRefused with DiagnosticBase.
challenge.real_collision: Tooth 1 of test_ask_reaches_a_launched_codemother (0c2c3f53c2be) holds that inspect_wire imports nothing under cairn.devices.codemother. Importing cairn.tools.base.diagnostic keeps that.

answers.falsifier: The sieve returns no finding for cairn/tools/inspect_wire, and InspectRefused stays a RuntimeError with the same message, args, judge, reason and raised.
answers.from_idea: none, because the build inspector measured it 2026-11-16 as the live trouble inspector-new-finding-every-class-reaches-the-diagnostic-mixin, naming cairn/tools/inspect_wire/inspect_wire.py:96, and the orchestrator ruled the shape
answers.how: InspectRefused takes DiagnosticBase as its first base, as AmbiguousComponent does in cairn/tools/base/address.py. A red-first proof asks the sieve over the bus for cairn/tools/inspect_wire and holds InspectRefused's message, args and attributes unchanged.
answers.traces_to: Law 9 (green is earned) and Akien's ruling open-4141d959b634: every class with code inherits the diagnostic mixin. The sieve every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin is that ruling's physics, and it reds here.
answers.what: inspect_wire's InspectRefused reaches DiagnosticBase, so every class with code in inspect_wire can run a diagnostic report and the mixin sieve stands clear there.

bullets.text: InspectRefused, added by 3e08102ef35a, was the one class in inspect_wire outside the diagnostic mixin. It now takes the base.

title: inspect_wire's InspectRefused reaches DiagnosticBase, so every class with code in inspect_wire can run a diagnostic repo
